messages:
Alex W.: Heads-up — noticed a p99 prefill spike after last night's kernel-heuristics rollout. p50 unchanged, p95 +10ms, p99 +120ms. Anyone tracking?
Priya R.: Yep got the alert at 03:18 UTC. Looking at traces now. Do we have KV hit-rate breakdown? :thinking:
Mateo L.: KV miss rate jumped around the same time as the rollout. Quick profiler dump shows: 
```
stage    p95    p99   avg_kv_miss
prefill  34ms  210ms   43%
decode   18ms   22ms    6%
```
Jin K.: That 43% kvcache miss is huge. The new kernel selector seems to prefer a prefill path that disables our KV warmup in some cases. Possibly a side-effect from the microbatch scheduling change.
Alex W.: In staging I tried lowering microbatch size for prefill only (8 -> 4) and p99 dropped ~90ms. Throughput dropped ~12% though.
Priya R.: Our SLO is 200ms p99 for inference. Prod is at ~210ms right now so we crossed the SLO. Options: revert rollout, tweak batcher heuristics, or accept throughput hit and bias for smaller microbatches for prefill.
Mateo L.: Operational plan proposal:
1) short term: canary a config with `microbatch_max=4` for 10% traffic + extra kvcache metrics.
2) medium: modify batcher to pick smaller batches for requests with long prefill sequences (>128 tokens).
3) long term: add kernel-selector signal from kvcache-warm metric so we don't pick cold-prefill kernels.
Jin K.: I'll add a canary flag. Suggest `route.prefill_small_batch=true` and limit to 10% traffic via rollout. Also add per-request `kvcache_hit` and `kernel_choice` fields to logs.
perf-bot: deploy pipeline started for canary config (job: deploy/canary-prefill-smallbatch).
Alex W.: PR incoming for the canary + logging. If canary doesn't improve within 15m we'll revert the heuristics change. Anyone object?
Priya R.: :thumbsup: no objections. We need an alert on canary p99 regressions too.
Mateo L.: Add a quick inline profiler snippet to the canary so we can see prefill/decode split per kernel: 
```
# sample from canary trace
request_id: abc123
kernel: prefill_fastpath
prefill_ms: 72
decode_ms: 20
kvcache_hit: false
```
Jin K.: Config draft for the route: 
```yaml
route:
  prefer_prefill_small_batches: true
  microbatch_max: 4
  kv_warm_threshold: 0.6
```
Alex W.: Timeline: start canary in 30m, watch p95/p99 and overall throughput. If p99 <= 200ms on canary we keep and expand; else we rollback kernel heuristics entirely. I'll post updates.
perf-bot: canary started at 2301122600, traffic=10%
Priya R.: First 5m look: canary p99 185ms, p95 48ms, throughput -9% vs baseline. KV miss rate on canary down to 18%. Looks promising.
Mateo L.: Nice. If numbers hold let's plan a staged ramp and a follow-up to bake kernel-selector changes.
Alex W.: Great. Leaving this open — will update after 30m window. Thanks all.
